_comment: RN-05 SQS seccomp baseline (ported from the Go daemon supervisor/seccomp_baseline.json). NOTE: `--security-opt seccomp=<path>` REPLACES the container runtime's default profile (the OCI spec carries exactly one seccomp filter — there is no stacking), so this file IS the whole filter: ALLOW by default with a hand-curated ERRNO deny-list of high-risk syscalls (kernel module loading, mount changes, reboot, ptrace, io_uring, etc.) so a sandbox escape via a kernel CVE has fewer levers. Because the default profile is displaced, every dangerous syscall the runtime default would have blocked must live on this deny-list — when in doubt, ADD here.

syscalls.comment: Deny operations a sandbox script has no business performing. Rejected with EPERM so glibc-style fallbacks behave gracefully.
